nodes.statement:
Under Assumption ass1, for any $t>0$ we have
\begin{align}

\int_0^t\big|\overline p_{0}(s)-\overline p_{n}(s)\big|^2\mathrm{d} s \lesssim \frac{1}{n^2},\qquad n\geqslant1,
\end{align}
and
\begin{align}

\int_0^t\big|\overline p_{0}(s)+\overline p_{n}(s)\big|^2\mathrm{d} s \lesssim  \frac{\log
  (n+1)}{n^2},\qquad n\geqslant1.
\end{align}

We define, for any $x \in {\mathbb I}_n$,  and any $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$ such that $\mathrm{Re}(\lambda) >0$, the Laplace transforms:
$$
\widetilde{\overline p}_x(\lambda):=\int_0^{+\infty}e^{-\lambda t}{\overline p}_x(t)\mathrm{d}
t,\qquad \widetilde{\overline \tau}_+(\lambda):=\int_0^{+\infty}e^{-\lambda t}{\overline \tau}_+(t)\mathrm{d} t
$$
and
$$
\widetilde{{\overline r}}(\lambda,k):=\int_0^{+\infty}e^{-\lambda t}\widehat{\overline r}(t,k)\mathrm{d} t,\qquad \widetilde{{\overline p}}(\lambda,k):=\int_0^{+\infty}e^{-\lambda t}\widehat{\overline p}(t,k)\mathrm{d} t.
$$
